thread:
Alex G: Quick heads-up — I'm out the week of Mar 3 and need someone to lead the ARB on Wed. Can anyone pick up the lead slot?
Maria Chen: I can do it for Mar 3 if nobody else, but I have a tight calendar — would prefer to split facilitation with someone.
Kevin O'Neill: I can take the first 20 minutes (RFC reviews) and handoff to Maria for design reviews.
Samir Patel: Happy to cover triage and ops bits. Also, can we prioritize RFC-1234 (KV-cache rewrite)? It has prod perf implications.
Tess P: Agree on RFC-1234. Quick ask — can we formalize the agenda to save time? Small template:
```
1) Quick round (2m)
2) RFC reviews (20m) — owner + devs
3) Design review / deep dive (20m)
4) Triage / action items (8m)
5) AOB / scheduling (5m)
```
Alex G: Love that template. Kevin/Maria/Samir — does this distribution work? Also please add any slides or short PR links before EOD Tue so we can slot them.
Kevin O'Neill: Adding link to RFC: https://redwood/repo/rfcs/1234 — will drop a 2-slide note in the agenda thread.
Maria Chen: Adding design review PR: https://redwood/repo/pulls/789 — it's mostly about batching heuristics.
Samir Patel: Triage note: backlog has 14 items; I'll highlight 3 high-priority ones.
Alex G: If no objections, I'll update the calendar invite to show Kevin as co-lead for the first half, Maria as second. @arb-bot can you post the updated invite and set reminder for 24h before?
arb-bot: Calendar updated: ARB Wed Mar 5 10:00-11:00 (UTC). Reminder set 24h prior. Invite: https://calendar/redwood/arb-mar5
Tess P: One more — let's add a 5-minute 'roll call' at the top for new members to flag conflicts. Keeps run-on discussions shorter.
Alex G: Good call. I've added a roll-call item. Thanks all — tagging the owners: @Kevin O'Neill (RFCs), @Maria Chen (design), @Samir Patel (triage). Please drop slides/links by Tue EOD. :thumbsup:
